description: Official FX rates — all eight pairs. All eight official African exchange rates vs USD in one payload (Kenyan, Tanzanian and Ugandan shilling, naira, cedi, rand, Egyptian pound, Rwandan franc), via Frankfurter (frankfurter.dev). Same blend and the same as_of / source fields as the single-pair shelf. $0.02 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.
